title: Quasi-Product States and Factor Types for the One-Dimensional Hard-Core Model
summary: We study the von Neumann algebra generated by a quasi-product state associated with the one-dimensional hard-core lattice gas. If \(κ>0\) denotes the activity (fugacity), the transfer-matrix construction gives the stationary transition matrix \[ P=\begin{pmatrix}p&q\\ 1&0\end{pmatrix}, \qquad p+q=1, \qquad κ=\frac{q}{p^2}. \] The stationary Markov measure on the hard-core path space induces a faithful diagonal state on the corresponding path \(AF\)-algebra. We give a state-preserving identification of its GNS von Neumann algebra with the Feldman--Moore algebra of the measured tail…
